answer: At dawn each epoch, a reef audit checks every identity's quartz signature against the registry. Each identity needs two guarantor bonds of 175,000 POA posted by its operator; when the audit ties two identities to one operator, both are voided, their rewards burned, and the bonds pass to honest peers. One fake therefore costs about 608,000 POA — 258,000 POA of lost reward plus 350,000 POA in forfeited bonds — so five fakes lose about 3,040,000 POA.
